brief_jobs_status.name: brief_jobs_status
brief_jobs_status.value:
"brief_jobs"."status" IN ('queued', 'running', 'ready', 'failed')
      AND ("brief_jobs"."status" = 'running') = ("brief_jobs"."lease_id" IS NOT NULL AND "brief_jobs"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL)
      AND ("brief_jobs"."status" = 'ready') = ("brief_jobs"."candidates" IS NOT NULL)
      AND ("brief_jobs"."status" = 'failed') = ("brief_jobs"."failure" IS NOT NULL)

comments_subject.name: comments_subject
comments_subject.value:
(
      ("comments"."subject_kind" = 'project' AND "comments"."subject_id" = "comments"."project_id" AND "comments"."work_id" IS NULL)
      OR ("comments"."subject_kind" = 'task' AND "comments"."work_id" IS NOT NULL AND "comments"."work_id" = "comments"."subject_id")
      OR ("comments"."subject_kind" IN ('document', 'meeting') AND "comments"."work_id" IS NULL)
    )

comments_content.name: comments_content
comments_content.value:
char_length(btrim("comments"."body")) BETWEEN 1 AND 4000
      AND cardinality("comments"."mention_ids") <= 20 AND "comments"."version" > 0

comments_resolution.name: comments_resolution
comments_resolution.value:
("comments"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "comments"."resolved_by" IS NULL)
      OR ("comments"."parent_id" IS NULL AND "comments"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "comments"."resolved_by" IS NOT NULL)

decisions_one_successor_idx.name: decisions_one_successor_idx
decisions_one_successor_idx.where: confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND supersedes_id IS NOT NULL

work_items_blocker.name: work_items_blocker
work_items_blocker.value:
"work_items"."blocker_reason" IS NOT NULL OR
    ("work_items"."blocker_owner_id" IS NULL AND "work_items"."blocker_resolution" IS NULL)
